system.boundary: Build a physically causal closed-loop liquid-cooling system for a data center.
engineering_objects: Build a physically causal closed-loop liquid-cooling system for a data center.

The plant must contain a server heat source, a chilled-water loop, a separate condenser-water loop, a real water-to-water heat exchanger, a chiller path between the loops, and a cooling tower coupled to ambient temperature and relative humidity.
Separate physical pumps must circulate the two water loops.
physical_paths: Build a physically causal closed-loop liquid-cooling system for a data center.

The plant must contain a server heat source, a chilled-water loop, a separate condenser-water loop, a real water-to-water heat exchanger, a chiller path between the loops, and a cooling tower coupled to ambient temperature and relative humidity.
Separate physical pumps must circulate the two water loops.
functional_paths: The chiller must regulate its evaporator outlet to about 18 degC, the chilled-water pump must respond to server outlet temperature to keep it near its intended operating range around 28 degC, and the condenser-water pump must respond to the condenser-to-tower temperature difference around 6 degC.
Internal controller form and chiller implementation are not prescribed.
Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named thermal_state, flow_control_state, heat_power_state, and environment_state.
